title: A FPGA Engineering Test Method for Federated Learning System

pse.problem: Complex structure and many test points make direct testing of FPGAs for federated learning systems difficult, especially when the working state of the FPGA is hard to judge from the outside.
pse.solution_function: The system performs FPGA engineering testing by using a host computer to send configuration data and test source data to an FPGA. The FPGA processes the test source data according to the configuration data in designated modules to obtain test result data.
pse.solution_structure: The heterogeneous processing system consists of a host computer and an FPGA with multiple computing modules. The FPGA can process test source data based on specified test configuration data.
pse.solution_implementation:
1. Host computer sends configuration data to FPGA.
2. Host computer sends test source data to FPGA.
3. FPGA receives and records the test source data according to the configuration data.
4. The designated test module processes the test source data to obtain test result data.
pse.effect: The method allows for targeted testing of specified modules, narrows the scope of troubleshooting, and improves the efficiency of FPGA engineering testing.
